extension.summary: A Streamlined Utility Tool for Kodi
extension.description: No Bloatware, no Nonsense! Just Keep your Kodi sharp and clean with this utility tool... Now with a Custom Wizard. The "++" fork backs up and restores over Kodi's VFS, so Backup Location / Restore can point straight at a network share (nfs://, smb://) or any VFS path, not just local storage.
extension.news:
2026.06.30.17 - One-Tap Restore is now a proper menu item, not buried in Settings. Open the add-on and choose ONE-TAP RESTORE: pick a pinned backup to restore it, or pin a new one. Restoring your box no longer lives under Settings. 2026.06.30.16 - One-Tap Restore now RESTORES. Each pinned slot has a RESTORE action: it fetches and validates the pinned backup, and only after you confirm does it wipe this Kodi and restore it. The box is never wiped until the backup is downloaded and confirmed a valid zip. Slots now show the pinned zip name and size. 2026.06.30.15 - One-Tap Restore (foundation): a new Settings tab to pin a specific backup (a network/local file or a Dropbox backup) to a slot and verify it still exists and is a valid zip. Replaces the old Wizard Creator. One-tap restore-from-pin is the next step. 2026.06.30.14 - Authorship cleanup: the add-on's listed author is now its maintainer only. The original EZ Maintenance+ authors are credited in the project README, not in the app. 2026.06.30.13 - Fixes the add-on not appearing in the Kodi 19+/Omega add-on browser. It now declares xbmc.python 3.0.0 compatibility; without it Kodi treated the add-on as incompatible and hid it from Program add-ons entirely. 2026.06.30.12 - Restore is faster: removed the diagnostic full-CRC scan that was added while tracking down the large-backup corruption (now fixed), which added ~20s to every restore. 2026.06.30.11 - The restore download bar now fills correctly (the total size is read from Dropbox's metadata, since the download is streamed without a Content-Length). 2026.06.30.10 - The "Downloading from Dropbox" step during restore now shows a real progress bar (percent and MB) instead of a static "Please Wait". 2026.06.30.9 - Fixes large-backup restore failing partway (BadZipFile: Truncated file header). A full backup was including a partial copy of itself under temp/, and on restore that entry overwrote the staged zip mid-extraction. Restore now skips the temp/ tree, and backups no longer include temp/ at all. This is what was breaking Apple TV restores. 2026.06.30.7 - Restore verifies the downloaded backup is fully readable (CRC) the moment it arrives, before extracting, to pinpoint where a large backup can get corrupted. 2026.06.30.6 - Restore now logs exactly how many files it extracted vs errored and verifies the tree on disk afterward, so a restore that does not take effect can be diagnosed precisely instead of silently reporting success. 2026.06.30.5 - Restore now works on Apple TV (tvOS), not just Fire TV/Android. After extracting, it re-applies your Kodi settings through Kodi's own API and rescans add-ons (like the official Backup add-on), so the restore survives tvOS's NSUserDefaults/cache behavior instead of silently reverting. It now restarts cleanly (Quit) and reports how many settings were applied. 2026.06.30.4 - Restore is now honest and self-checking: it verifies the downloaded backup is a valid, non-empty zip before extracting, reports how many items it restored, and shows a clear error (with the byte count) instead of falsely reporting success when the download came up empty. The streamed download also fails loud on a 0-byte file. 2026.06.30.3 - Dropbox sign-in is now more secure and self-contained: it uses PKCE, so the add-on no longer needs (or ships) any app secret, and the sign-in QR is generated right on the device (no outside QR service - works on any network). - Long backups are more resilient: the device is kept awake during a backup, and a brief network stall now resumes the current chunk instead of restarting the whole upload. 2026.06.30.2 - The sign-in QR is now generated for your build and ships inside the add-on, so it appears even when the device cannot reach an outside QR service (no external dependency). Falls back to a fetched QR, then the plain URL, if needed. 2026.06.30.1 - Dropbox upload now shows a real progress bar (percent and MB) instead of a frozen bar, and you can cancel it; a canceled upload never touches your last backup. - Dropbox sign-in shows a scannable QR code: point your phone at it, approve, then enter the short code. No more typing a long URL on the remote (falls back to the URL if the QR can't be generated). 2026.06.30.0 - Dropbox large-file uploads are now resilient on slow connections (e.g. a Fire TV or Apple TV wifi uplink): smaller upload chunks, each chunk retried with backoff, and the session resumes from Dropbox's own offset instead of restarting the whole upload. Big backups (100 MB and up) that used to time out now complete. 2026.06.26.2 - Backup safety fixes: a failed Network/SMB/NFS copy now reports an error and never prunes your last good backup (the failed ship is no longer treated as success). - Keep-N rotation now orders backups by the in-name date stamp, not the raw filename, so a renamed/mixed-name backup set can never delete the newest one. - Dropbox: single-shot uploads stream from disk (no whole-file buffer); a broken download cleans up its partial temp file and creates the temp folder if missing. - Build no longer ships lint/cache cruft (.ruff_cache, __pycache__) inside the zip. 2026.06.26.1 - All-in-one backup tool: pick a Destination - Local, Network (SMB/NFS), or Dropbox. - Dropbox is one-tap: Settings -> Backup/Restore -> Destination = Dropbox -> Sign in, paste one code, done. No app to create, no keys to type (talks to the Dropbox REST API directly, no SDK). Backup uploads, Restore lists and pulls straight from Dropbox. - Keep-N rotation: set how many backups to keep; the oldest are pruned only AFTER a new backup lands, so a failed run never deletes your last good backup. 2026.06.26.0 - EZ Maintenance++ : forked from EZ Maintenance+ (aenema, peno). - Backup now writes through Kodi VFS: the zip is staged locally then copied to the Backup Location, so nfs:// / smb:// / any network share works (not just local paths). - Restore reads the same way: the zip list and the selected zip are pulled over VFS, so you can restore directly from a network share. 2026.04.05.0 - Updated for Kodi 22 2023.01.09.0 - Added AutoClean Cache functionality every x days at a given hour. - Backup always replaced the home folder reference in xml files with special://home Not all addons can handle this replace so it is now possible via a setting to disable this. - Backup Cancel didn't work. This is now fixed.
2023.01.01.0 - Fix a fix on 2022.12.28.0
2022.12.28.0 - Fix crash with full backup when there are foreign, like Hebrew, characters in xml files
2021.12.19.0 - Made kodi 19 (Matrix) compatible.
2021.11.03.0 - Fix Speedtest crash.
2020.12.19.1 - The plugin was also installed under Video add-ons. Now it only is in Program add-ons where it belongs - Clean removed some files created by Common plugin cache or StorageServer or script.common.plugin.cache at kodi startup. This resulted in breaking cache functionality of kodi - Upload kodi log file to pastebin didn't always work and the first bytes were binary characters - Made all decode calls UTF-8 - Improved ADVANCED SETTINGS(BUFFER SIZE) functionality

extension.summary: Shared install library for the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons
extension.description: Internal Python library used by the Tony.7.Bones Setup add-ons. It is not runnable on its own and does not appear on the home screen; it provides the shared add-on install, dependency-resolution and Kodi-integration machinery the Setup add-ons depend on.
extension.news: v1.5.0: Onboarding self-creates the _T7B/kodi/{backups,iptv,media,repositories,rss} device tree (ensure_device_dirs / DEVICE_STAGING_SUBDIRS); IPTV staging is injected only when the iptv/ dir actually holds artifacts. (v1.4.0: Device-resident master env at the _T7B/ brand root (dot-optional env.<device>), ordered env-source search (brand root -> staging _T7B/kodi/ -> legacy kodi/tony.7.bones/ -> profile-local), persistent master never deleted, self-scaffolding placeholder template when no env exists. (v1.3.0: Ordered env-source layer — BOX_ENV_PATH (pushed env wins) then the profile-local env, with read_first_env/box_env_paths/delete_box_envs helpers and terminal deletes covering every candidate; SETUP_API 2. (v1.2.0: Modular Setup layers — re-entrant apply_foundation/apply_iptv/apply_addons (each leaves a complete working box), installed-state probes + assert_box_complete (dependency-closure walk), the PVR-disabled config window for pvr.iptvsimple instance-settings writes, staged-IPTV artifact consumption (host-built m3u/groups/instance files), keep-skin activation hardening (verify-then-re-assert with skinshortcuts quiescence), and the SETUP_API version guard.)

extension.description: Installs repositories and add-ons for a personal Kodi build.
extension.news: v1.8.0: Setup creates the device folder structure (_T7B/kodi/{backups,iptv,media,repositories,rss}) on every run if missing — Express, Guided, and the no-env wizard all scaffold it. (v1.7.0: Setup reads each box's own env.<device> from /storage/emulated/0/_T7B/ (created as a disabled placeholder if missing) so a box self-configures with no computer; the device-resident master env is persistent and never deleted; unattended Express + Guided wizard unchanged. (v1.6.0: Launching Setup with no device env now opens the Guided wizard — choose Foundation / IPTV / Add-ons, or "Install everything with defaults" — so a manual launch installs nothing until chosen; the unattended Express one-tap still runs whenever a device env is present. (v1.5.0: Modular Setup — Express one-tap unchanged; three standalone layers (run_foundation, run_iptv, run_addons), each leaving a complete working box; Guided wizard via SETUP_MODE=guided with per-gate restarts and the Model A lifecycle (Setup persists across gates, env consumed at Finish, then self-uninstalls); shared-library SETUP_API compatibility guard. (v1.4.0: Per-device config from one .env — the provisioner derives a per-device tony7bones.env and the Setup reads it to set weather (up to 5 locations + optional Weatherbit/OpenWeatherMap keys), IPTV (custom groups + m3u/EPG), and RSS feeds, then removes it; built-in defaults when absent. (v1.3.3: Live TV now loads only the custom channel groups — the Setup enforces pvr.iptvsimple's "Only load TV channels in groups" (tvChannelGroupsOnly) alongside the custom-groups mode + file. (v1.3.2: Reliable skin activation — Setup now ACCEPTS Kodi's "Keep this skin?" confirmation when it switches to Estuary MOD V2, so the choice persists across the end-of-setup restart instead of reverting to stock Estuary. (v1.3.1: Adds three File-Manager sources — "special://home" (special://home), "special://kodi" (/storage/emulated/0/kodi/), and ".tony.7.bones" (https://tony7bones.github.io/). New sources de-dupe by name and path; and ANY existing source pointing at the repo URL — with or without a trailing slash, under any label — is renamed to ".tony.7.bones". (v1.3.0: one-shot also installs + activates the Estuary MOD V2 skin and the MOD V2+ patch auto-applies via its service.)

extension.summary: Lean enhancements for Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: A small, non-destructive set of enhancements for skin.estuary.modv2 (Estuary MOD V2), built fresh against the Omega release. Reorders the gear Settings menu so Skin Settings sits above Media sources, and adds a dedicated "Tony.7.Bones MOD V2++" Skin Settings category that is home to our tweaks. The System Info overlay is hidden by default (toggle renamed "Disable System Info overlay"), the top-bar weather icons default to the Outline HD set (resource.images.weathericons.outline-hd), and the clock and navigation wordmark each have a per-item toggle that defaults to the stock look. The category also carries in-tab Apply and Restore buttons. Run after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Apply and Restore are both available — original files are backed up once and never overwritten, and Restore reverts every change cleanly.
extension.news: v1.4.10: New V2++ icon - the bottom wordmark now reads "Tony.7.Bones V2++". v1.4.9: Renamed to Estuary MOD V2++ (the display name and the "Tony.7.Bones MOD V2++" Skin Settings category) to match the ++ line. Same add-on id, no functional change. v1.4.8: Home menu reliability fix — (re)deploying our home menu now CLEARS script.skinshortcuts' built cache for skin.estuary.modv2 AND drops the built menu hash in one step, so skinshortcuts always regenerates from OUR trimmed menu (Live TV, Movies/TV shows, Add-ons, Favorites, Weather) on the next boot. Defeats the caching race where a live skin-switch built and cached the stock Estuary menu before our menu deployed, leaving the wrong menu on a fresh box. (v1.4.7: First-boot persistence fix — the look settings (weather in the header, Outline HD icons, plain Power/Settings/Search backgrounds, classic power menu) now write straight to settings.xml on apply, so a freshly-provisioned box shows them on the FIRST boot instead of stock; the boot service also re-applies them if they are ever missing (settings-aware gate). (v1.4.6: Home menu now deploys the exact saved layout verbatim — the six-item trim, Movies/TV shows open POV, TV opens the Guide, the Favorites relabel, and the Movies List / TV Shows List widgets — and self-heals (re-deploys) if a skin update or a build race ever resets it. (v1.4.5: Home menu now reliably trims to six items even when Setup's live skin-switch raced script.skinshortcuts into caching the full stock menu — the service detects the un-trimmed menu and rebuilds it on the next boot. (v1.4.4: the auto-apply service now waits for the Home screen to actually render (not just for the skin to be set) before patching, fixing the occasional blank/unfinished home after a restart. (v1.4.3: new V2+ icon; channel numbers off. v1.4.2: TV opens the Guide, Favourites→Favorites, six home widgets hidden.)
